12-biomarker_concordance_plot



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)






# 12.1 Import Data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
raw_data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/raw_data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"


metadata_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "metadata_df_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data",
    "protein_mat.csv"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  check.names=F
)

full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_full.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  check.names=F
)

colnames(full_vsd)[1] <- "gene"

ensg2gene <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "host_gene_counts.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  { setNames(.$gene_symbol, .$X) }

full_vsd <- full_vsd %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene[gene],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  )






# 12.2 Prepare RNA/Protein concordance for selected genes


genes_to_plot <- c(
  "FABP4",
  "ISG15",
  "IFIT2",
  "IFIT3",
  "APOE",
  "SLAMF7",
  "OLAH",
  "SDF2L1",
  "GLRX",
  "FAH",
  "C1QC",
  "SCIMP",
  "APOC1"
)


prepare_gene_concordance <- function(
  selected_gene,
  full_vsd,
  protein_mat,
  metadata_df
) {

  # RNA
  rna_gene_long <- full_vsd %>%
    filter(gene_symbol == selected_gene) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(gene, gene_symbol),
      names_to = "sample_name",
      values_to = "expr"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_scaled_rna = as.numeric(scale(expr))
    )

  # Protein
  protein_gene_long <- protein_mat %>%
    { colnames(.)[1] <- "patient_id"; . } %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id = as.character(patient_id)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      patient_id,
      all_of(selected_gene)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -patient_id,
      names_to = "gene_symbol",
      values_to = "expr"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      expr_scaled_protein = as.numeric(scale(expr))
    )

  # Merge RNA, protein, and metadata
  metadata_df %>%
    mutate(
      patient_id = as.character(patient_id),
      LRTI_group = recode(
        LRTI_adjudication,
        "Definite" = "LRTI",
        "No Evidence" = "Control"
      )
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      rna_gene_long,
      by = "sample_name"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      protein_gene_long,
      by = c("patient_id", "gene_symbol")
    )
}






# 12.3 Scatter plot RNA vs Protein for selected gene


for (selected_gene in genes_to_plot) {

  gene_concordance <- prepare_gene_concordance(
    selected_gene,
    full_vsd,
    protein_mat,
    metadata_df
  )

  # Pearson
  pearson_res <- cor.test(
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna,
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein,
    method = "pearson"
  )

  pearson_r <- round(
    pearson_res$estimate,
    2
  )

  pearson_p <- signif(
    pearson_res$p.value,
    2
  )


# Scatter plot RNA vs Protein


  p <- ggplot(
    gene_concordance,
    aes(
      x = expr_scaled_rna,
      y = expr_scaled_protein
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 2,
      alpha = 0.7,
      color = "#0072B2"
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1.0,
      color = "grey30",
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 0.25,
      fullrange = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12,
      base_family = "Arial"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        selected_gene,
        "RNA/protein concordance"
      ),
      x = "RNA expression (z-score)",
      y = "Protein expression (z-score)"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = max(
        gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna,
        na.rm=T
      ) + 0.25,
      y = max(
        gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein,
        na.rm=T
      ),
      label = paste0(
        "r = ", pearson_r,
        "\np = ", pearson_p
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3.5,
      lineheight = 1.2,
      family = "Arial"
    ) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "black"
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "plain",
        size = 12
      ),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t=10,
        r=20,
        b=10,
        l=10
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(
        min(
          gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna,
          na.rm=T
        ) - 0.2,
        max(
          gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna,
          na.rm=T
        ) + 0.2
      ),
      ylim = c(
        min(
          gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein,
          na.rm=T
        ) - 0.2,
        max(
          gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein,
          na.rm=T
        ) + 0.2
      ),
      clip = "off"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0(
        selected_gene,
        "_RNA_vs_Protein_concordance.pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5,
    device = cairo_pdf
  )

}







# 12.4 Scatter plot RNA vs Protein by adjudication


interaction_results <- data.frame(
  Biomarker = character(),
  Interaction_p = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


for (selected_gene in genes_to_plot) {

  gene_concordance <- prepare_gene_concordance(
    selected_gene,
    full_vsd,
    protein_mat,
    metadata_df
  )

# Scatter plot colored by adjudication


  # Pearson per group
  pearson_definite <- cor.test(
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna[
      gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"
    ],
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein[
      gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "Definite"
    ],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  pearson_noevidence <- cor.test(
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_rna[
      gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "No Evidence"
    ],
    gene_concordance$expr_scaled_protein[
      gene_concordance$LRTI_adjudication == "No Evidence"
    ],
    method = "pearson"
  )

  r_definite <- round(
    pearson_definite$estimate,
    2
  )

  r_noevidence <- round(
    pearson_noevidence$estimate,
    2
  )

  # BH correction across the 2 group-wise tests
  p_vals_adj <- p.adjust(
    c(
      pearson_definite$p.value,
      pearson_noevidence$p.value
    ),
    method = "BH"
  )

  padj_definite <- signif(
    p_vals_adj[1],
    2
  )

  padj_noevidence <- signif(
    p_vals_adj[2],
    2
  )

  # p value
  interaction_p <- summary(
    lm(
      expr_scaled_protein ~
        expr_scaled_rna *
        as.character(LRTI_adjudication),
      data = gene_concordance
    )
  )$coefficients[
    "expr_scaled_rna:as.character(LRTI_adjudication)No Evidence",
    "Pr(>|t|)"
  ]

  interaction_results <- rbind(
  interaction_results,
  data.frame(
    Biomarker = selected_gene,
    Interaction_p = interaction_p,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )

  interaction_label <- ifelse(
  interaction_p < 0.001,
  "Interaction p < 0.001",
  paste0(
    "Interaction p = ",
    formatC(interaction_p, format = "f", digits = 2)
    )
  )

  label_text <- paste0(
  "LRTI: r = ", formatC(r_definite, format = "f", digits = 2), "\n",
  "Control: r = ", formatC(r_noevidence, format = "f", digits = 2),
  if (selected_gene == "GLRX") {
    paste0("\n", interaction_label)
  } else {
    ""
    }
  )


# Scatter plot RNA vs Protein by adjudication


  p <- ggplot(
    gene_concordance,
    aes(
      x = expr_scaled_rna,
      y = expr_scaled_protein,
      color = LRTI_group
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      size = 2.5,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE,
      linewidth = 1.0,
      alpha = 0.20,
      fullrange = TRUE,
      xseq = seq(-3, 4, length.out = 100)
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey70"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey70"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
      "LRTI" = "#D55E00",
      "Control" = "#8B4789"
      ),
      breaks = c(
      "LRTI",
      "Control"
      ),
      labels = c(
      "LRTI",
      "Control"
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 12,
      base_family = "Arial"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        selected_gene,
        "RNA/protein concordance"
      ),
      x = "RNA expression (z-score)",
      y = "Protein abundance (z-score)",
      color = NULL
    ) +
    
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = -2.8,
      y = Inf,
      label = label_text,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1.3,
      size = 14 / 2.845,
      lineheight = 1.0,
      color = "black",
      family = "Arial"
    ) +
    
    theme(
      text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(
        color = "black",
        size = 16
      ),
      axis.title = element_text(
        face = "plain",
        size = 16
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "plain",
        size = 16
      ),
      legend.position = c(0.5, 0.08),
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.text = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      legend.title = element_text(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 16,
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t=10,
        r=20,
        b=10,
        l=10
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-3, 4),
      ylim = c(-3, 4),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
  
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-3, 4, 1),
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x),
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-3, 4, 1),
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x),
    )

  print(p)

    ggsave(
    file.path(
      results_dir,
      paste0(
        selected_gene,
        "_RNA_vs_Protein_concordance_by_adjudication.pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 6.5,
    device = cairo_pdf
  )

  # Save Figure 3C, 3D, and 3E plot objects for patchwork
  if (selected_gene == "FABP4") {
    saveRDS(
      p,
      file.path(
        results_dir,
        "figure3C_FABP4_adjudication.rds"
      )
    )
  }

  if (selected_gene == "ISG15") {
    saveRDS(
      p,
      file.path(
        results_dir,
        "figure3D_ISG15_adjudication.rds"
      )
    )
  }

  if (selected_gene == "GLRX") {
    saveRDS(
      p,
      file.path(
        results_dir,
        "figure3E_GLRX_adjudication.rds"
      )
    )
  }

}
